/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, re
ppt='/home/user/Desktop/Dickinson_Slides.pptx'
ns={'p':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main','a':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'}
with zipfile.ZipFile(ppt) as z:
    for name in sorted([n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('ppt/notesSlides/notesSlide') and n.endswith('.xml')], key=lambda x:int(re.search(r'(\\d+)',x).group(1))):
        root=ET.fromstring(z.read(name))
        print('\\n--', name)
        for sp in root.findall('.//p:sp', ns):
            ph=sp.find('.//p:ph', ns)
            typ=ph.get('type') if ph is not None else None
            texts=[t.text or '' for t in sp.findall('.//a:t', ns)]
            if texts:
                print('type=',typ,'TEXT=',repr('\\n'.join(texts)))
PY"
